en.text: I will bless the LORD at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.

footnotes.text: 34:1 Psalm 34 is an acrostic poem, with each verse starting with a letter of the alphabet (ordered from Alef to Tav).

zhSimplified.text: 我要时时称颂耶和华； 赞美他的话必常在我口中。

zhTraditional.text: 我要時時稱頌耶和華； 讚美他的話必常在我口中。

en.text: My soul shall boast in the LORD. The humble shall hear of it and be glad.

zhSimplified.text: 我的心必因耶和华夸耀； 谦卑人听见就要喜乐。

zhTraditional.text: 我的心必因耶和華誇耀； 謙卑人聽見就要喜樂。

en.text: Oh magnify the LORD with me. Let’s exalt his name together.

zhSimplified.text: 你们和我当称耶和华为大， 一同高举他的名。

zhTraditional.text: 你們和我當稱耶和華為大， 一同高舉他的名。

en.text: I sought the LORD, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.

zhSimplified.text: 我曾寻求耶和华，他就应允我， 救我脱离了一切的恐惧。

zhTraditional.text: 我曾尋求耶和華，他就應允我， 救我脫離了一切的恐懼。

en.text: They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.

zhSimplified.text: 凡仰望他的，便有光荣； 他们的脸必不蒙羞。

zhTraditional.text: 凡仰望他的，便有光榮； 他們的臉必不蒙羞。

en.text: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.

zhSimplified.text: 我这困苦人呼求，耶和华便垂听， 救我脱离一切患难。

zhTraditional.text: 我這困苦人呼求，耶和華便垂聽， 救我脫離一切患難。

en.text: The LORD’s angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华的使者在敬畏他的人四围安营， 搭救他们。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華的使者在敬畏他的人四圍安營， 搭救他們。

en.text: Oh taste and see that the LORD is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.

zhSimplified.text: 你们要尝尝主恩的滋味，便知道他是美善； 投靠他的人有福了！

zhTraditional.text: 你們要嘗嘗主恩的滋味，便知道他是美善； 投靠他的人有福了！

en.text: Oh fear the LORD, you his saints, for there is no lack with those who fear him.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华的圣民哪，你们当敬畏他， 因敬畏他的一无所缺。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華的聖民哪，你們當敬畏他， 因敬畏他的一無所缺。

en.text: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek the LORD shall not lack any good thing.

zhSimplified.text: 少壮狮子还缺食忍饿， 但寻求耶和华的什么好处都不缺。

zhTraditional.text: 少壯獅子還缺食忍餓， 但尋求耶和華的甚麼好處都不缺。

en.text: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 众弟子啊，你们当来听我的话！ 我要将敬畏耶和华的道教训你们。

zhTraditional.text: 眾弟子啊，你們當來聽我的話！ 我要將敬畏耶和華的道教訓你們。

en.text: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?

zhSimplified.text: 有何人喜好存活， 爱慕长寿，得享美福，

zhTraditional.text: 有何人喜好存活， 愛慕長壽，得享美福，

en.text: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies.

zhSimplified.text: 就要禁止舌头不出恶言， 嘴唇不说诡诈的话。

zhTraditional.text: 就要禁止舌頭不出惡言， 嘴唇不說詭詐的話。

en.text: Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.

zhSimplified.text: 要离恶行善， 寻求和睦，一心追赶。

zhTraditional.text: 要離惡行善， 尋求和睦，一心追趕。

en.text: The LORD’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华的眼目看顾义人； 他的耳朵听他们的呼求。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華的眼目看顧義人； 他的耳朵聽他們的呼求。

en.text: The LORD’s face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华向行恶的人变脸， 要从世上除灭他们的名号。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華向行惡的人變臉， 要從世上除滅他們的名號。

en.text: The righteous cry, and the LORD hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.

zhSimplified.text: 义人呼求，耶和华听见了， 便救他们脱离一切患难。

zhTraditional.text: 義人呼求，耶和華聽見了， 便救他們脫離一切患難。

en.text: The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华靠近伤心的人， 拯救灵性痛悔的人。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華靠近傷心的人， 拯救靈性痛悔的人。

en.text: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him out of them all.

zhSimplified.text: 义人多有苦难， 但耶和华救他脱离这一切，

zhTraditional.text: 義人多有苦難， 但耶和華救他脫離這一切，

en.text: He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.

zhSimplified.text: 又保全他一身的骨头， 连一根也不折断。

zhTraditional.text: 又保全他一身的骨頭， 連一根也不折斷。

en.text: Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.

zhSimplified.text: 恶必害死恶人； 恨恶义人的，必被定罪。

zhTraditional.text: 惡必害死惡人； 恨惡義人的，必被定罪。

en.text: The LORD redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华救赎他仆人的灵魂； 凡投靠他的，必不致定罪。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華救贖他僕人的靈魂； 凡投靠他的，必不致定罪。
